triage.reason: Faithful composite replication of book figure 15.3 (and underlying data for figure 15.4). Source map (BEA NIPA + IMF IFS) verified against Appendix 15.1. MIXED_UNITS flag is genuine and is resolved here by per-subseries units (levels in USD billions, rates as decimals, deflator as index).
